MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This member no longer exists or isn't visible to you.
MEMBERS_LAST_OWNER: An organization needs at least one active owner. Make someone else an owner first.
MEMBERS_OWNER_ROLE_RESTRICTED: Only owners can add, change or remove owners.
MEMBERS_PRIMARY_TEAM_NOT_A_MEMBER: The primary team must be one of this member's teams.
MEMBERS_ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a member of the organization.
MEMBERS_ALREADY_INVITED: This person already has a pending invitation. Resend it instead.
MEMBERS_TRANSFER_REQUIRED: This member owns agents or flows. Choose who takes them over.
MEMBERS_TRANSFER_TARGET_INVALID: This person can't take over the agents and flows. Choose an active member.
INVITATION_NOT_FOUND: This invitation doesn't exist or is no longer valid.
INVITATION_EXPIRED: This invitation has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
INVITATION_REVOKED: This invitation was withdrawn. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
INVITATION_ALREADY_ACCEPTED: This invitation has already been accepted. Sign in to continue.
INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign in with that address.
